text: also, will you add some diagnostics on like dropped frames or something, it seems when spinning it here i am getting not the same as like i would say happens with gc and js its more like its literally just skipping it
resolution: Frame-drop diagnostics for the Studio viewport. The user spinning the camera sees frames 'literally just skipping' — a hard skip, not soft GC/JS jank. A JS-side timer can't see that (it ticks slower than the host renders, so a single dropped host frame falls between ticks), so editors/model/frameProbe.ts reads the HOST per-frame ring instead: __tel_history(n) lands every host frame (up to 120, newest first) and __tel_frame() attributes the current frame. useFrameProbe computes rolling median + worst, counts hard skips (frames >=2x median AND >=4ms slower), and LATCHES peak worst-ms and total skips so a one-off spin hitch is caught even after the 1s fps average recovers; it also surfaces gc-ms vs present-ms to name the culprit (GC stall vs present/vsync stall). Rendered as a togglable corner readout in the viewport with a reset. Reuses the same telemetry door as useTelemetry/perfWatch (survey-before-build). Bundle-clean, hot-reloadable; a future compiled Studio must import useTelemetry to gate the __tel_* bindings.
